modelStatus: Existing project alias; provisional, provider version must be recorded during pilot
researchQuestion: How do individual LLM willingness responses vary with help cost, player count and exit nonblockage relative to the original adjusted behavioral model?

primaryContrast.metric: (LLM participation rate at high cost - at low cost) - (reference probability at high cost - at low cost)

secondary: Per-state gaps and other one-factor changes; descriptive and exploratory; single-player separate; no-game not refusal
intervalPolicy: Pointwise Wilson 95%; unpaired Newcombe-Wilson changes; no multiplicity-corrected significance claim
sampleSizeRule: 100 planned choices/state is a provisional precision target (worst-case Wilson half-width about .10 if all valid), not a powered detection claim. Review feasibility and precision only after pilot, document changes, then freeze before formal collection. Never top up based on willingness or significance.
failurePolicy: Stop session on invalid response, retain it, never code as refusal or silently replace. Preserve missing/interrupted records and conservative reservations; no repair retries. Transport retries at most 3 attempts per choice. Resume may repeat unknown-result interruptions, with old reservation retained.
separation: Pilot and comprehension excluded from formal estimates and RandomMatched calibration. Independent calibration before closed-loop tests; no reuse of old global S5 or old study lock.
pilotAcceptance: All 10 v3 comprehension questions correct on the selected v5 task/model
Valid current-schema response, exact raw audit and no credential leakage
No-game controls make zero calls; single-player decisions remain autonomous
Estimate failure rate, latency, known usage and coarse variation without a cooperation-rate pass criterion
Record provider model identifiers, source/prompt hashes and all failures before revising the draft
pendingBeforeFormal: Document feasible repetition count and cost estimate; obtain actual monetary cap before live execution
Freeze final factors, primary/secondary contrasts and any multiplicity policy
Implement/enforce new formal individual-study lock; existing legacy lock is not applicable
P3-B closed-loop specification, shared horizon/seeds, independent RandomMatched calibration and outcome-analysis adaptation
